observedCoverage.evidence: Native log byte 75971722 and screenshot 02 record a confirmed draw: Intel 3 -> 2 and copies [1,1,1,1,1,1] -> [1,2,1,1,1,1], with the Saved receipt. Initial action packets are incomplete, so the actual log/screenshot supplies the outcome.

Three equipped active slots show passive controls as SLOTS FULL. The recorded mixed draft removes Repairs and adds passive Hull; Cancel restores the original active selection. Later compact Apply saves the mixed future selection.

Full-hull R and a full-hull pointer attempt keep Repairs unused; Q/E/R during the menu pause leave tick183 and all uses unchanged. Actual Q, E and pointer input subsequently activate Overdrive, Minefield and Repairs. Repeated spent input does not grant another use.

Overdrive activates at tick 360 with 240 ticks remaining, decrements at 361/362, and reaches 0 at 600 (12 simulated seconds). Minefield arms at 666, then changes armed -> false at 1039 while kills 9 -> 10 and a detonation cue is logged. Ordinary Repair first heals 1220 -> 1223 at 1260; accepted Emergency Repairs at 1261 changes 1223 -> 1232 on that same tick. Exactly one each skill-overdrive, skill-mines-armed and skill-repairs activation cue occurs; skill-minefield is the separate later detonation. The reopened and fresh logs contain no skill cue events.

Compact Armory applies the saved passive preset and launcher+repair selection. Checkpoint before close and after future-build application is equal both as objects and as the exact1898 serialized bytes (SHA2562d1f9a270bd6dbc3a5f0ad8e85bedc108777b48580dce981ed42b4e36dbcc79a). It retains repair-only equipment, original active skills, tick1525/hull1220/completedWave2/spentMask7.

The same executable reopens at960x600. Actual Resume restores the captured active run paused at tick1525/hull1220, despite the passive future selection. Explicit simulation resume preserves spent uses, and Q cannot activate Overdrive again.

Actual new-run confirmation creates isolated run3 with launcher+repair and Hull/Ballistics/Lining. Hull is1355 versus the prior active build maximum1232. Q and pointer input on the passive Hull card do not create an active use; the run subsequently confirms wave1. This native observation does not separately quantify every passive modifier.
